name: file-viewer
title: File Viewer
description: One viewer for any file: detects the type and lazy-loads the matching renderer (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, images) plus inline, virtualized text/code/JSON, Markdown (sandboxed), and HTML (sandboxed). Only the needed parser is ever downloaded.
